outputs.location: Under the heading 'Data Availability' following the Methods (after the Polysome seq subsection, before Acknowledgements).
outputs.issues: Statement is present but not formatted to journal requirements: (1) Datasets are not listed as separate bullet points (multiple data types combined in a single sentence). (2) Some entries lack required metadata fields per format: the TAD dataset (GSE89112) is not labelled with a measurement type (e.g., Hi-C/TAD) and lacks a resolvable URL; the SRA run SRR488282 is listed without a full resolvable link or study accession (SRP/GSE) and without an explicit measurement type for the CAGE data. (3) The GEO entry (GSE292611) is given inline but not as a separate bullet; the token string ('Token: enmlkucylhkxfmb') is unexplained and should be removed or clarified. Please reformat into separate bullet points where each bullet states: measurement type; repository name/acronym; accession/DOI; and a resolvable link (identifiers.org or full URL).
